T: Why so serious. It's only dinner.
D: Batman, Gordon and the new district attorney take on a criminal mastermind who wants Gotham in chaos.
P: Serve the mains when Bruce drags his date over to join Rachel and Harvey's dinner table.
S: Beef and horseradish cream on toast, salmon and crème fraîche on blinis
Seared beef fillet on crostini with horseradish cream, smoked salmon blinis with crème fraîche and chives, served on black trays.
Roast pork belly cubes glazed with hoisin and honey, quick pickled cucumber
Char siu pork belly cubes roasted with honey, hoisin and five-spice, on toothpicks with pickled cucumber.
Joker card cheddar crackers with red dip
the playing card the Joker leaves behind

Crisp cheddar and parmesan crackers cut into playing card rectangles, a paprika smile stencilled on, with a smoky roasted capsicum dip. Pulse 150g plain flour, 120g grated cheddar, 30g parmesan, 60g cold butter and a pinch of cayenne until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water. Roll 3mm thick, cut into 5 x 8cm rectangles, dust a smile of paprika through a paper stencil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Blend 200g roasted capsicum, 50g almonds, 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp smoked paprika, lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil for the dip.
M: Pan-seared salmon in foaming caper butter with crushed baby potatoes

Pan-roasted salmon on crushed potatoes with a nutty lemon and caper brown butter and a peppery rocket and parmesan salad. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan for 5 minutes, then flip for 2 minutes. Wipe the pan, melt 80g butter until it foams brown, then add 2 tbsp capers, the juice of a lemon and chopped parsley. Toss 100g rocket with shaved parmesan, oil and lemon. Plate the salmon on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.
late nights at the police station

Beef and pork meatloaf baked under a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with buttery mash, gravy and green beans. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, chopped parsley and salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp cider vinegar and brush half over. Bake at 180C for 50 minutes, brushing on the rest halfway. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mash, beans and gravy made from 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: Baked lemon cream tart in a sweet pastry case, dusted with powdered sugar
Crisp pastry with a smooth, sharp lemon cream, finished with icing sugar. Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes.
K: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour
Blended Scotch, lemon and honey ginger syrup shaken and poured over one big ice cube

Blended Scotch shaken with fresh lemon and a honey ginger syrup, served over a big ice cube with a float of smoky Islay malt and candied ginger. Simmer 80g honey, 80ml water and a thumb of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. For each drink shake 50ml blended Scotch, 20ml lemon juice and 20ml of the syrup hard over ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler, float 5ml smoky Islay whisky on top and garnish with a piece of candied ginger.

Toast the baguette slices.
Top the toast with beef and horseradish cream.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and chives.
Serve on black trays.

veg.make_ahead: Best made fresh, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Sear the mushrooms in a hot oiled pan until browned, splash with the soy, then rest and slice thin.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top the toast with mushroom and horseradish cream.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with a squeeze of lemon. Top the blinis with creme fraiche, beetroot and chives.
Serve on black trays.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the pork in the hoisin, honey and five spice.
Roast, glazing twice, until sticky and cooked through.
Quick pickle the cucumber in the vinegar.
Serve the pork on toothpicks with the cucumber.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Pat the tofu dry and toss in the cornflour, oil and five spice.
Roast on a lined tray until crisp, turning once.
Warm the hoisin and honey, toss through the tofu and roast again until sticky.
Quick pickle the cucumber in the vinegar.
Serve the tofu on toothpicks with the cucumber.

Season the salmon and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan, then flip.
Wipe the pan, melt the butter until it foams brown, then add the capers, lemon juice and parsley.
Toss the rocket with parmesan, oil and lemon.

veg.n: Joined-tables crisp tofu with caper butter

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush with some of the oil and salt.
Pat the tofu dry, dust with the cornflour, salt and pepper and fry in a hot oiled pan until crisp on both sides.
Wipe the pan, melt the butter until it foams brown, then add the capers, most of the lemon juice and the parsley.
Toss the rocket with the cheese, the last of the oil and lemon.
Plate the tofu on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.

ingredients.item: sheet of sweet shortcrust pastry, for a 23cm tart

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm tart tin and blind bake.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon juice, zest and cream.
Pour in and bake at 150C until just set.
Chill the tart well.
Dust with icing sugar to serve.

dishes.n: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
For each drink shake Scotch, lemon juice and syrup hard over ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler.
Float the smoky whisky on top and garnish with candied ginger.

af.n: Alfred's smoky Scotch and ginger sour (alcohol-free)

ingredients.item: smoky black tea leaves, such as lapsang souchong

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Steep the smoky tea leaves in the boiling water for 4 minutes, strain and cool.
For each drink shake the black tea, lemon juice and syrup hard over ice.
Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler.
Float a teaspoon of the smoky tea on top and garnish with candied ginger.

s.note: Beef and horseradish cream on toast, salmon and crème fraîche on blinis
s.how: Sear a 300g eye fillet to rare, rest and slice thin. Toast baguette slices and top with the beef and horseradish cream. Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and chives. Serve on black trays.

s.note: Roast pork belly cubes glazed with hoisin and honey, quick pickled cucumber
s.how: Cut 800g pork belly into cubes and toss with 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp five spice. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, glazing twice. Quick-pickle a sliced cucumber in rice vinegar. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Pan-seared salmon in foaming caper butter with crushed baby potatoes
m.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan for 5 minutes, then flip for 2 minutes. Wipe the pan, melt 80g butter until it foams brown, then add 2 tbsp capers, the juice of a lemon and chopped parsley. Toss 100g rocket with shaved parmesan, oil and lemon. Plate the salmon on the potatoes and spoon over the butter.

w.note: Baked lemon cream tart in a sweet pastry case, dusted with powdered sugar
w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs, 150g sugar, 150ml lemon juice, lemon zest and 150ml cream, pour in and bake at 150C for 30 minutes until just set. Chill and dust with icing sugar.

Strain over a large ice cube in a tumbler, float 5ml smoky Islay whisky on top and garnish with a piece of candied ginger.
